name: Diagramly Desktop
subtitle: Mermaid & ZenUML diagrams
promotionalText: Create editable Mermaid and ZenUML diagrams on your Mac. Keep your documents local and connect a compatible MCP client to revise them.
description:
Diagramly Desktop is a local workspace for editable ZenUML and Mermaid diagrams.

CREATE AND EDIT
Write ZenUML or Mermaid source and see the diagram update. Organize work in documents and pages, then save and reopen it on your Mac.

CONNECT YOUR AI AGENT
Connect a compatible MCP client to the desktop app and let it read or update the open diagram. Your MCP client and any AI model may require a separate account or subscription.

IMPORT A ZENUML LIBRARY
Import the JSON library exported by the older ZenUML desktop app. Review imported documents and pages, then continue editing their diagram source. Import reports identify styles that need attention.

LOCAL BY DEFAULT
Your documents stay on your Mac unless you choose to connect an external service or agent. Diagramly cloud AI, account entitlements and Apple subscriptions are not available in this release draft.

This draft describes the local desktop spike. Confirm every claim against the signed App Store build before submission.
